'''2012 European Championship Marc Nickels LS Restore Freedom To The Galaxy''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Marc Nickels]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7)|Restore Freedom To The Galaxy / We'll Need A New One]]
* '''Username:''' Darkbow
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
